text_block_list.text:
An event called "Invitation to Another 
World" was held at a department store, and 
I ended up attending with Marvelous Sunday 
and the others.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Um, it says to take Elevator 4 and press 
the buttons in a specific sequence. Ahaha☆ 
My heart's racing even before getting on★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of place another world 
is! I've got an extra-large helping of 
marvelous premonitions!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Another world♪ Another world♪ I'm 
so excited~♪

"It's merely a department store event, but 
the two of them seem to be looking forward 
to the fantasy world from the bottom of 
their hearts. Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Seems like it? Still, fewer people 
might set the mood better♪ All right, take 
off to another world!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The fourth floor is a bookstore. Hmm, 
nothing seems out of the ordinary with the 
books or the staff. Let's head to the next 
floor.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Next, go to the 2nd floor, then the 6th 
floor, back to the 2nd floor, and finally 
to the 4th floor—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
We've arrived in another world☆ is what it 
means! Mmm~~! So thrilling and 
marvelo~~us★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous & Mayano
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? What's with that book's title... 
"Hiua%@, koghe99"...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Look, you two! The letters in the books on 
this floor have all changed☆
choice_data_list: In such a short amount of time...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
D-Does that mean Maya and the others 
really ended up in another world...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazingâ Marvelous! Let's go 
check out the other floors tooâ

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey... isn't this floor supposed to 
be...
choice_data_list: I was sure this was a clothing store...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha☆ It's an isekai movie theater! 
Oh, look, there's a trailer playing on the 
monitor!

Ahssdfghhjk, queermuyhh... ppo-ishulk! 
/,mnb...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I-Is this really a trailer? All it shows 
is a bunch of squiggly, wiggly stuff, and 
I can't even tell what the lines are 
saying...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's a bit sad to see it end, but it 
was truly marvelous! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Please, please, reach the first floor...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"No way, no way! Why! Why aren't we 
reaching the first floor! Ugh, I hate 
this~~!"

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Clerk
text_block_list.text: qaszxe rfr&by@tj;m

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Customer
text_block_list.text: "pl, j6$＊tgbhhhyu・,iu＊"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hyaa! N-No, stay away from me~!
choice_data_list: B-both of you, you need to run!
B-both of you, run away quickly!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: B-But run away where?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Mhm, mhm. I seeee! So that's how it is☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: M-Mave-chin...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You see, it seems our desire to go to an 
alternate world accidentally connected us 
to this one.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelousness transcends space and time☆ 
Ahaha★ This is a major marvelous 
discovery☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Hate to ruin the mood when you're so 
happy, but can Maya and the others really 
get back to our original world?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Of course! All we need to do is make 
another marvelous coincidence happen☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! We're Umamusume— we've made 
miracles happen time and time again, and 
right now, we're right in the middle of 
one! ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Coincidences and miracles are all 
Marvelous☆ When you're Marvelous, there's 
nothing you can't do!★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, when Mave-chin tells you that, 
it really makes you feel like you can do 
it, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya believes in Mave-chin and Marvelous! 
If we could come to another world, there's 
no way we can't go back! Marve~lous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep, both of you are super marvelous☆ 
Come on, now's our chance to make a 
miracle together!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Here we goooo~! Marveeeeeelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Clerk
text_block_list.text: ghjkli.p。

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all so much too! I hope you'll 
always remember today's miraculous 
Marvelous! ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "Farewell, other world! Ahahahaha☆"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, is this the first floor of the 
building...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hardly any time has passed at all... Was I 
just dreaming, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Maybe so! Or maybe not! Either way—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Isn't it super marvelous right now?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...That's true. It was a little scary, 
but my heart is pounding like crazy!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Thank you for the marvelous 
fun, Mayano☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Good morning, you two! Waking up outdoors 
is simply marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—*yawn*~~ Huh? Where are we? Weren't we 
supposed to be at the building...?
choice_data_list: Looks like we made it back...
Looks like we made it back...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but I'm somehow completely wiped 
out... I just wanna hurry home and sleep 
in a real bed...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we're gonna have some marvelous 
dreams☆
